# `hospital_cost_report_measures`

**Selected hospital cost report measures**

Explicit beds, costs, charges and net patient revenue at their original worksheet locations.

**Coverage.** Sampled by design. Local candidate scope is CMS-2552-10 fiscal-year-start 2010. CMS publishes the highest status available for a facility/period; superseded submissions absent from its extract are unavailable. Every available filing and cell survives. No public delivery or wider historical coverage is implied. Costs, charges, revenue and Medicare settlement are distinct; settlement is not a selected measure. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `hospital_cost_report_measures.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `report_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal HCRIS RPT_REC_NUM; join only within the same pinned original. |
| `ccn` | `VARCHAR` | Six-character CMS Certification Number validated through RefSpec; not a hospital system identifier. |
| `fiscal_begin` | `DATE` | Reported fiscal start date; original spelling remains in raw_report_json. |
| `fiscal_end` | `DATE` | Reported fiscal end date; original spelling remains in raw_report_json. |
| `measure` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit supported measure; no inferred rollups or substitutions. |
| `unit` | `VARCHAR` | beds or USD for the selected worksheet measure; other raw cells carry no inferred units. |
| `provider_scope` | `VARCHAR` | Hospital for S-3 beds, worksheet C Part I total for costs/charges, or financial statement reporting entity for G-3 revenue. These scopes are not interchangeable. |
| `worksheet` | `VARCHAR` | Literal seven-character WKSHT_CD; unknown worksheets remain native facts. |
| `line` | `VARCHAR` | Literal five-character LINE_NUM including the subline suffix. |
| `column` | `VARCHAR` | Literal five-character CLMN_NUM including the subcolumn suffix. |
| `value_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal original cell text. Empty string differs from numeric zero; NULL in measurements means an absent source cell. |
| `value` | `DECIMAL(38,12)` | Exact DECIMAL(38,12) from the reported value; unavailable or unrepresentable values remain NULL. |
| `value_status` | `VARCHAR` | value, absent_cell, blank, non_numeric, unrepresentable or invalid_bed_count. Unknown markers retain original spelling. |
| `source_archive_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Exact selected ZIP SHA-256; report identities and coordinates are scoped to this original. |
| `source_member` | `VARCHAR` | Original ZIP member name; absent measurement cells have no member locator. |
| `source_member_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the complete decoded CSV member, independently checked before use. |
| `source_record_number` | `BIGINT` | One-based source CSV occurrence; duplicate raw cells remain distinct occurrences. |
| `source_byte_offset` | `BIGINT` | Zero-based original byte offset in the decoded member, before CP1252/CSV decoding. |
| `source_byte_length` | `BIGINT` | Exact original record byte length including source line endings. |
